models.title: Badr
models.hook: The wells were held. What did the ground decide?
models.plate_alt: Badr in 3D: two opposed formations with banners and spears on a dawn plain, the wells and the camp behind them.

models.title: Uhud
models.hook: Forty archers left the hill. What followed?
models.plate_alt: Uhud in 3D: a line of faceless archers on a rocky hill above the plain.

models.title: Khandaq
models.hook: The trench held. What broke the Confederates?
models.plate_alt: Khandaq in 3D: the trench cutting across the plain between two armies, the fort of Banu Qurayza and the marsh beyond, with Sila' at the Muslim rear.

models.title: Khaybar
models.hook: The forts fell in turn. Who carried the banner?
models.plate_alt: Khaybar in 3D: a chain of stone forts on the dark shelf above palm groves, the Muslim camp below and the chief fort al-Qamūṣ to the east.

models.title: Muʿtah
models.hook: Three standards fell. Who carried the banner?
models.plate_alt: Muʿtah in 3D: the Muslim army and the reported enemy host on either side of the dry wādī, the three command standards between them, the village on its tell and the olive groves beyond.
